notes.title: 🐧🍀 Alpha Update is here!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173174/1257877d14d5704adb2514f56db6d063a48e68e6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]🍀 Alpha Update is here! 🌱[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173174/8189de2d069085881df6084066a1a76d7afe0621.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey Explorers![/p][p]It’s amazing to have such a dedicated community! <3 Thanks to your feedback, we’re ready to share a brand new version of Astrobotanica! This time we’ve prepared new tools, deeper pet systems, new building options, smoother gameplay, and plenty of balance updates to make your journey even more fun.[/p][p][b]Keyboard binding[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Full keyboard control customization — set up your own keybinds.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Xbox controller support[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Full Xbox controller compatibility (PlayStation DualSense support coming later!)[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Interaction changes[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Improved “hold” interactions for better usability and responsiveness.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Tutorial text updates[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Clearer and more helpful guidance for new players.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Pet system[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Taming: the ability to tame wild pets.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Personality system: each pet has unique traits you’ll need to learn.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Trust system: pets won’t run away if they trust you, but low trust may cause them to leave.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Mood system: low mood can make pets ignore commands; higher mood will be needed for future features like expeditions.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Behaviors & commands: basic actions (more coming later!)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Curiosity system: pets will explore and react to their surroundings.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Feeding: feeding pets impacts their trust[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]New tool: Pickaxe[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Unlockable after completing the alpha (building the totem). Used for gathering basic resources.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]New building/housing options[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]More construction options — expand your settlement with new building options.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Buildings now only need to be unlocked once.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Trading with the caveman[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]A simple trading system: buy items from Ube using Knowledge; sell resources through the Contribution Box.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Inventory & chest improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Better inventory management and smoother chest system functionality.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Movement improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]More fluid and responsive character movement.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Visual updates (level art)[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Adjustments and polish to the world’s visuals.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Game balance[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Reduced CO₂ consumption at night; increased consumption while sprinting.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Adjusted CO₂ warning sound: now triggers at 10%.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Adjusted low HP warning sound: no longer loops constantly.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Stamina regeneration increased up to 15%.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]On death, you no longer lose your inventory — instead, you lose 15% of your current Knowledge.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Increased Knowledge rewards from repeatable activities.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Rebalanced plants: stats and distribution.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Lowered cavemen disease frequency.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]QoL updates[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]A range of quality-of-life improvements and bug fixes.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]We can’t wait to see your lush gardens, big homes, and cute pets - share them with us on [url="https://discord.gg/G4QVyFYsMK"]Discord[/url]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173174/8189de2d069085881df6084066a1a76d7afe0621.png"][/img][/p][p]Reminder: [b]Alpha access ends September 15th[/b] - after that, the alpha will no longer be available.[/p][p]But good news: Astrobotanica will be part of [b]October’s Steam Next Fest[/b]! Everyone will be able to try the [b]public demo[/b], which will also get a bit of extra polish before release.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173174/8189de2d069085881df6084066a1a76d7afe0621.png"][/img][/p][p][url="https://linktr.ee/Astrobotanica" style="button"]Linktree with our social media links[/url][/p][p]Thank you for being part of the Astrobotanica community.  Let’s grow something extraordinary, together! 🌱🌟[/p]

notes.title: How we plan to develop ASTROBOTANICA
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome, Alien Adventurers![/h1]
Today we are excited to share the next key stages in development for [b]ASTROBOTANICA[/b], our upcoming botany-centric survival game that has been generating significant buzz since the official game reveal back in August. Here are the key milestones for the coming months:
[list]
[*][b]Kickstarter Campaign[/b] to speed up and expand development
[*][b]Closed Alpha Testing[/b] to allow hands-on access to the game for kickstarter backers
[*][b]Public Demo Release[/b] to showcase our progress and open to feedback from broad audience
[/list]
[i]New screenshots from the game’s engine are also presented to our Steam followers at the end of this update.[/i] 

We invite everyone to [b]wishlist [/b]and [b]follow [/b]ASTROBOTANICA on Steam and connect with us on social media for the latest updates. This will ensure that announcements and updates will appear in your library, so be sure to do this if you want to not miss anything!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2720920/ASTROBOTANICA

[h2]Kickstarter Campaign Coming Soon[/h2]
We are glad to announce that just in a couple of months we will be launching a [b]Kickstarter campaign[/b]. With your support, we hope to accelerate the game's development and to enhance the initial design to make the game bigger, longer and even more engaging. Stay tuned for details such as pledges, goals, and reward tiers, and of course, unique features available only via Kickstarter.

[h2]Alpha Testing for Backers[/h2]
As one of several initiatives to engage our community in the development of the game, we’re planning to invite [b]Kickstarter backers[/b] to play a closed Alpha build via Steam. This holds true to the studio’s promise to work on ASTROBOTANICA transparently and act on community feedback. We hope you’re as excited to play the game long before anyone else, as we are to invite players this early into the development cycle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173174/1ce6cf09358b0f86ffbae77b7b4d62b3022cee6b.jpg[/img]

[h2]Public Demo[/h2]
Following the Alpha testing, we plan to implement all feedback, and go ahead with a release of public Demo via Steam in the second half of the year. This will provide an excellent opportunity to showcase the results of the community collaboration. By inviting more players to immerse in the vibrant world of [b]ASTROBOTANICA[/b], we hope to test every aspect of the game, and to generate new ideas and suggestions for the next milestone - Early Access release. Details will be announced once we make progress and plans crystallize. Thus, follow us to not miss any important details.

[h2]Let’s Brainstorm Together[/h2]
We warmly invite you to join our [b]Discord community[/b] right now, and participate in discussions, see new screenshots first, exchange thoughts and ideas, discuss your favorite games, and spend good time in good company. 
Feel free to also visit our [b]Steam forum[/b], where we’re available and eager to talk and connect with other players.

[h3]Join here:[/h3]
[url=https://discord.gg/G4QVyFYsMK][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173174/60a1fd99c92f1ce40d20a9ba3c10dc7042bcba57.png[/img]
[/url]
[b]Discord:[/b] https://discord.gg/G4QVyFYsMK

[b]Steam Forum:[/b] https://steamcommunity.com/app/2720920/discussions/

[h2]ASTROBOTANICA Gameplay[/h2]
Set 300,000 years ago during Earth’s Pleistocene era, [b]ASTROBOTANICA [/b]invites players into a lush open-world environment full of primal flora and fauna. As an alien botanist named [b]Xel[/b], you will navigate survival challenges and engage in:
[olist]
[*] [b]Cultivation:[/b] Nurturing plant species and learning how to manage farming in Earth's environtments.
[*] [b]Plant research:[/b] Experimenting with fruit to discover their unique qualities and effects on living organisms and the environment.
[*] [b]Exploration:[/b] Discovering new plants in diverse biomes, learning to tackle dangerous wildlife and solve hidden mysteries.
[*] [b]Tonics Crafting:[/b] Mixing ingredients obtained from local plant life to manufacture mixtures for various uses, and developing recipes for later.
[*] [b]Human Interaction:[/b] Breaking the ice and connecting with primal humans inhabiting the islands, to foster relationships that can lead to trading or mutual assistance.
[/olist]
There’s much more to ASTROBOTANICA, which you will have the opportunity to experience firsthand very soon.

[previewyoutube=bs4qZ1vtldw;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Future Development Plans[/h2]
Among other ideas, we are planning on implementing co-op features for [b]ASTROBOTANICA [/b]at some point between the early access release and 1.0 launch. This multiplayer experience will allow players to collaborate by sharing resources, taking roles, changing shifts in game’s errands, and embark on adventures and exploration together. We are actively working on these features, thus, we invite you to participate in discussions on our socials and help shape the future of [b]ASTROBOTANICA[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173174/ec3dc816c2a2cc8dd51b5472da873fd1578aafb8.png[/img]

[h2]Newest Screenshots[/h2]
Have a look how the game’s visuals have evolved and the surroundings have developed in the last few months. Join us and share what you think!
